player_prompt.intro:
Say to agpeplay Blackjack laban ed dealer.
Say goal mo et kumada ed saray 21 a punto tan sayangka ibaga.
Ed say turn mo, pilien '[Hit]' a manggawa saray adi ka punto o '[Stand]' a tukoy.
J/Q/K = 10 puntos; A = 11 o 1, no ontan so mas mapalpalabas.
